reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 sets Quarrendon Freight Lines at **185 seats** for Pemberline Dock. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01. The account profile still shows 185 active seats.

I also told her that Amendment No. 3 raises the count to 230 seats from 2027-01-01, so 185 is the right number until then.

The figures come from the knowledge brain's copies of the North team's records for this account. I couldn't open the original contract file through the file share, so I didn't check them against it. A seat count is an operational fact, and Dana owns the account and is on the North team, so I could share it without approval. I left out all pricing and discount terms.
